description: Windows ASP.NET Core image that copies its local publish output with ADD instead of COPY. The file starts with the `# escape=`` parser directive, so the trailing backslash of a Windows path (`C:\temp\`) is not a line continuation: the URL fetch on line 10 is a complete instruction, and the local ADD on the next line is its own instruction. VC188 must fire on that local ADD. (A joiner that always treats a trailing backslash as a continuation swallows it into the URL fetch and loses the finding.)
